Command: Do not pervert justice for the poor
Summary: Do not wrest the judgment of the poor in his cause: poverty must not lose a man his case.
Commandment: Do not pervert justice for the poor.
Application: The poor man has no patron and no bribe to offer, which is exactly why the Law guards his cause expressly. A court that bends against the poor because they are poor has perverted judgment itself.
Purpose: TRADITIONAL reading: the poor are the most exposed to bent judgment, so the Law names their cause expressly; God is no respecter of persons in judgment.
Function: Government, not worship: the Law here is running a nation. Do not wrest the judgment of the poor in his cause: poverty must not lose a man his case.
